questions: Section 8 charges 25 for the father's stroke at 55 but refers applicants well past the family-history qualifying age to judgement. This applicant is 65. In house practice, is that 25 family-history debit charged in full, reduced, or waived for an applicant who is herself past age 60?

Section 16 refers combinations of cardiac risk factors to judgement. On this file the findings are BMI 30.4, A1c 5.8 with no diabetes diagnosis, HDL 43 with ratio 4.3, father's stroke at 55, BP 110/68 untreated, and total cholesterol 185. Does house practice treat this file as a combination of cardiac risk factors under section 16?

When section 16's combination of cardiac risk factors does apply to a file, what does house practice do with it: add a further debit on top of the individual table debits, move the class, or something else?
